layout.description: Where packages live: a pnpm workspace under packages/, flat at the repo root, or a single package at the root.

manager.description: The package manager CI installs with.

binds.description: The published @noy-db/hub seam this repo binds, or null when it binds none.

publishes.description: Whether this repo publishes packages to npm.

gates.description: The family gates CI runs for this repo.

localChecks.description: Shell commands CI's gates job runs after the family gates (for a repo with its own check script).

exempt.description: Package directory names excluded from every architecture rule.

allowHubRoot.description: Adds the @noy-db/hub ROOT BARREL to the subpaths this repo's bound seam may import. doi-db binds /to but needs isConflictError, which /to does not export.

conformanceKit.description: Test symbol the as-conformance-fixture rule looks for; omit to disable that rule.

license.description: The licence tier every publishable manifest must declare, and whose LICENSE + NOTICE must ship. Default Apache-2.0 (open core); premium repos say FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0.
